Overview.Name: Jaya Lakshmi Athram
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Feeling energetic & confident, Reducing PCOS-related issues, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1: Option 1: Egg omelette (2 eggs) + cucumber slices
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (~150 g) + curd
Meal_2 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) + vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg curry (2 eggs) + curd
Meal_3 (Dinner - light): Option 2: Curd rice (~150 g) + cucumber salad
Option 3: Paneer cubes (80 g) + vegetable fry

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid soy, potatoes and brinjal completely.
Reduce sweets and fried foods to support PCOS recovery and reduce cravings.
Shift work can disturb meal timing, so try to keep meals consistent daily.
Morning sunlight exposure and regular yoga can improve hormone balance and energy levels.
For boredom eating, drink water or buttermilk first before taking extra snacks.
Keep meals simple and home-cooked for better digestion and recovery.
